strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: There’s a hidden passage from{NEWLINE}the Team Rocket base in Mt. Mortar{CLEAR}that leads here. That’s how we came in.{SCROLL}But the Mahogany Town shop entrance{NEWLINE}opening wasn’t Team Rocket’s doing.{SCROLL}It’s because we just made a{NEWLINE}Team Rocket member open every{CLEAR}sealed passage in the base.

strings.zh: 渡『真不愧是联盟冠军。{NEWLINE}那你们找到电波发射装置了吗？
strings.en: Lance: That’s the League{NEWLINE}Champion for you. Have you found{CLEAR}the radio transmitter yet?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『还没有呢,{NEWLINE}我们只是刚打开通道,{CLEAR}现在正准备往更里面走。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Not yet. We only{NEWLINE}just opened the passages.{CLEAR}We’re about to head deeper in.

strings.zh: 渡『既然如此,那大家一起{NEWLINE}深入基地调查看看吧。
strings.en: Lance: In that case, let’s{NEWLINE}all go deeper into the base{CLEAR}together and investigate.

strings.zh: 渡『好,咱们走！
strings.en: Lance: All right, let’s go!

strings.zh: 你是联盟冠军吧？{NEWLINE}拜托你一定要打败火箭队啊,{CLEAR}不然我会死的很惨的。
strings.en: You’re the League Champion, right?{NEWLINE}Please, you have to beat Team Rocket.{CLEAR}Otherwise I’m in for a horrible death.
